callbackData.description: Optional data to include in webhooks (maximum 500 characters)

dailyCount.description: Number of times per day to run when isScheduled is true

descriptionPrompt.description: Prompt to guide the generated video description

duration.description: Duration preference for audio and slide deck generation. Ignored for video requests. For audio, `long` applies only to `deep dive` podcasts in English; other languages and styles have no long option and get the default length.

episodeTitle.description: Optional episode title when attaching to a podcast show

feedSelections.description: Cached feed items to include in the request (alternative to resources, topic, or researches)

format.description: For `video`, accepted values are `explainer`, `short`, and `cinematic` (defaults to `explainer`). `cinematic` video requests cost 100 credits. For `briefing_doc`, accepted values are `text`, `html`, and `pdf` (defaults to `pdf`). Ignored for other output types.

ignorePaywalledResources.description: When true, continue processing even if some URL resources fail to import (paywall/restrictions). The request fails only if none of the provided resources are successfully imported.

introImagePrompt.description: Prompt to control the intro image for video outputs

introMusicUrl.description: HTTPS URL to optional intro music (.mp3, .wav, or .m4a) mixed at lower volume at the start of the podcast

isScheduled.description: Create a recurring schedule instead of a single request

language.description: Target language for generated content, using an exact value from the supported languages list (for example, Deutsch). For video at the base format price, set language and omit voice1 and voice2. Voice IDs select narration voices but do not translate the generated script.

logoUrl.description: Optional HTTP or HTTPS PNG/JPG image URL for video, infographic, and slide_deck requests. Any source dimensions are accepted, but the image must be fully opaque and no larger than 5 MB; it is normalized to an opaque 200x50 PNG using the same rules as a project image. When supplied, it overrides the project logo for this request while project context and branding colors still apply. When omitted, the project logo and then the default logo are used.

notebookId.description: Owned Private Notebook ID. When present, generation uses that notebook's saved sources and its license's exact dedicated account, follows Private Notebooks capacity instead of content credits, and rejects additional request sources or generic topic/project inputs.

outputType.description: Type of output content to generate. In our check on 2026-11-02, `audio`, `video`, `slide_deck`, `infographic`, `quiz` and `datatable` requests completed; `briefing_doc`, `text`, `faq`, `study_guide` and `timeline` requests failed; they work again since 2026-11-05. Failed requests use no credits.

podcastEpisodeIds.description: Completed audio request IDs to reuse as podcast episode sources (max 10)

podcastId.description: Podcast show ID to associate this content with

projects.description: Array of project IDs to use as context for generation (max 10)

publishTargets.description: Targets to publish generated videos to (e.g., YouTube)

quizDifficulty.description: Difficulty level for quiz outputs (defaults to medium). Quiz prompt uses the main text field.

relatedId.description: Existing request ID to relate this request to (must belong to the same token)

researches.description: Array of research IDs to include as text resources (max 10)

resources.description: Resources for content generation (required if topic, feedSelections, or researches are not provided)

content.description: For type "file", provide an https URL or a file id returned by POST /files. For other types, provide the text or URL expected by that type.

scheduleEndDate.description: Optional end date for recurring schedules (requires isScheduled true)

scheduledOn.description: Schedule the content generation for a specific time

slideDeckFormat.description: Slide deck format (defaults to detailed). Length is controlled via the standard duration field (short, default, long). Slide deck prompt uses the main text field.

style.description: Style of the generated content. For audio/text, use one of: deep dive, brief, critique, debate. For video, NotebookLM preset names (auto-select, classic, whiteboard, kawaii, anime, watercolour, retro print, heritage, or paper-craft) are selected directly; any other value is used as custom style text and is limited to 5,000 characters. Video defaults to classic when omitted.

templateMode.description: Create a reusable template instead of processing immediately

name.description: Optional display name for the template

text.description: Instructions or query for content generation. For video, this is the NotebookLM steering prompt and is limited to 5,000 characters.

thumbnailImagePrompt.description: Prompt to control the generated thumbnail image for video outputs

title.description: Custom title to use for generated video outputs. When provided, overrides the automatically generated title.

titlePrompt.description: Prompt to guide the generated video title

topic.description: Topic for content generation (alternative to resources, feedSelections, or researches)

voice1.description: Primary explicit narration voice ID from /content/GetVoices. Use the numeric ID, not the voice name. For video, supplying any catalogue or client-cloned voice ID adds 200 credits once per request to the format base price (50 credits for explainer/short or 100 for cinematic). Omit voice1 and voice2 for base pricing. Voice selection does not translate the generated script.

voice2.description: Optional secondary explicit narration voice ID from /content/GetVoices. Requires voice1. The 200-credit video voice surcharge is per request, not per supplied voice.

youtubeChannels.description: YouTube channel IDs already connected to the account to use as sources

channel.description: (YouTube only) Channel handle, URL, or ID. Either `channel` or `url` may be provided.

feedTypeId.description: Type of feed (1 for X/Twitter, 2 for Reddit, 3 for YouTube channel, 4 for RSS, 5 for X News topic)

internalId.description: Internal identifier - Twitter username for X, subreddit name for Reddit (without r/ prefix), topic/search query for X News (feedTypeId=5), feed URL for RSS. For YouTube channels this is populated automatically.

author.description: Host/author name displayed on podcast platforms

description.description: Show description for platform listings and RSS feed
description.example: Weekly tech discussions generated by AI, covering the latest in technology and innovation.

email.description: Owner email address for RSS feed and platform registration

imageUrl.description: URL of the podcast show image/artwork

language.description: Primary language for generated podcast episodes (defaults to English)

link.description: Official website URL for the podcast show

name.description: Podcast show name (displayed on Spotify, Apple Music, etc.)

description.description: Detailed description of the project. Either description or url must be provided.
description.example: Building an AI-powered SaaS tool for content creators. Focus on automation, efficiency, and user experience.

imageData.description: Optional base64 encoded PNG/JPG representing the project's brand image. The source image must be fully opaque; images containing any fully or partially transparent pixels are rejected. Any dimensions are accepted and the API resizes the image to 200x50 before storing the hosted copy as `imageUrl`.

imageUrl.description: Optional HTTP/HTTPS URL to an existing PNG or JPG brand image. The source image must be fully opaque; images containing any fully or partially transparent pixels are rejected.
